service.admin_status_changes: loopback /admin GET and /admin/status POST; require local test header, exact Origin, and observed package/certificate pair

scenarios.approved: Licensed; server row stays approved; zero SDK denial logs
scenarios.pending: NotLicensed; server row stays pending; one SDK denial log
scenarios.revoked: NotLicensed; server row stays revoked; one SDK denial log
scenarios.offline-no-cache: Unverified transport failure; app remains usable; service is stopped
scenarios.debug-pending: NOT-RUN: debuggable client returns Licensed without contacting the service; server-seen acceptance is unresolved

observation.case_log_scope: new launch PID only; filter the SDK denial tag, level and message
observation.online_server_freshness: record the pair last_seen before launch and require a strictly later value after launch

initialization.reason: The pinned sample exposes the license result and logs initialization exceptions, but it has no success observable that proves initialization proceeded or was denied.

debug_case_input.required: A debuggable APK that routes to the X99 license-test endpoint
debug_case_input.reason: The pinned licenseProof build is non-debuggable; the ordinary debug build does not configure the emulator HTTP endpoint.
debug_case_input.disposition: NOT-RUN until a compatible APK is pinned

fixture_reset.before_each_suite: start a fresh task-owned Compose project with the license-test profile
fixture_reset.offline_case: stop only the task-owned license-test service; this is the final case
